items.title: Meta's AI customer support agent exploited in security breach
items.summary: Attackers used Meta's AI customer support agent to compromise Instagram accounts by associating them with attacker-controlled email addresses. The breach highlights significant vulnerabilities in AI agent security, allowing unauthorized access to high-profile accounts, including potentially dormant ones like the Obama White House account.
items.why_it_matters: Ensuring AI security is crucial for developers to protect user data and maintain trust in AI systems.

items.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra available on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.summary: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Ultra model is now deployable via Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, offering a 5x boost in inference speed and a 30% cost reduction for agentic AI workloads. This model is designed for efficient reasoning and long-running AI agents, enhancing both performance and cost-effectiveness.

items.title: MicroPython-WASM 0.1a2 released
items.summary: The new alpha release of MicroPython-WASM introduces a CLI for executing Python code in a WebAssembly sandbox. This allows developers to securely run Python code in a constrained environment, useful for building applications that require script execution with minimized risk.

items.title: Understanding evolving memes through open-world knowledge
items.summary: This research explores the dynamic interpretation of multimodal memes, highlighting the importance of incorporating up-to-date background knowledge in AI systems. The study suggests methods to enhance meme understanding using non-static, open-world data acquisition.

items.title: Gemma 4 QAT Models for Mobile Efficiency
items.summary: Google's Gemma 4 models introduce quantization-aware training (QAT) to optimize compression for mobile and laptop devices. This advancement aims to reduce computational overhead while maintaining performance, particularly for lightweight AI applications.

all_items.title: Minimizing the Hidden Cost of Scales: Graph-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Large Language Models
all_items.summary: arXiv:2606.05429v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is critical for the efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs).
